horoscope: The desire to improve and grow is strong and building for you, dear Aries, and today's New Moon can help bring a burst of energy in the direction of close relationships, and partnerships in particular! The week ahead is powerful for your connections, whether these unions are platonic, business, or romantic. It's a time for new beginnings and improvements to partnerships, or to your negotiation skills and general approach to relating. It could mean taking a relationship to the next level or making a connection that could lead to something significant. There can be some impulsiveness today, however, with a Venus-Mars square, so it would be wise to distinguish between making changes for the sake of change, and making changes that will genuinely propel you forward on an improved path. You are challenged to find the right balance between partnership and independence. Reacting is easy, but learning from your experiences is the smart thing to do now. Express your appreciation for people who matter most to you, especially if you're also driven to assert your independence. Tricky areas today tend to involve the sharing of money or responsibilities. You can experience pressures with someone or within yourself today over power dynamics, sharing, and intimacy. Today's Venus-Mars square can bring up some discontent or unrest, which can be informative but also frustrating. You should probably examine sudden desires and urges more closely, as they're unlikely to address genuine needs. In truth, it may take some energy and time to sort out what's real.

Today's New Moon brings strong, take-charge energy to your work and health pursuits, dear Taurus. Think about what needs to go — even if it's intangible, like a bad attitude — so you can enjoy life more fully in these areas: service, daily routines, healthy living, work, and contribution, with a new beginning ahead. It may be about a new job, focus, or project, but for most, this cycle is about getting on top of daily schedules and routines and taking better care of your everyday life. You are highly motivated to start fresh, but pace yourself so you don't burn out quickly. Get the plan right in the next few days before pushing forward. With a Venus-Mars square, the day's energies can be temperamental, and it can be all too easy to get into disagreements. Values, goals, or ambitions may clash, creating tension or frustration. Others may misinterpret your intentions, or you theirs, and people seem more competitive than cooperative today. There can be some unrest or emotional fireworks to manage, particularly in family relationships and partnerships. This transit stirs tensions that have been brewing under the surface of things. The desire for companionship might conflict with the need to work things out for yourself. You may be dealing with impatience or bad timing in your interactions. Aim not to stir the pot and be on the lookout for others trying to push your buttons. Save important ideas or topics for a more free-spirited time, but pay attention to problem areas, especially if they keep resurfacing.

Today's New Moon occurs in a romantic, playful, creative part of your solar chart, dear Gemini, which can bring fun energy into your life over the coming week. This cycle encourages you to explore your creative and romantic side more heartily. You might start or deepen a romantic relationship, enjoy a new artistic focus, or renew interest in a hobby or creative activity. New opportunities or channels for expressing and enjoying yourself can open up. With today's Venus-Mars square, your plate is full, and a surprise element from the past might emerge. It can be difficult to be productive without succumbing to distractions, and there can be a tendency to take things very personally. A timing problem can surface. Somebody may be using a rough or insensitive approach, or on the opposite end, an approach that isn't straightforward enough, and a disconnect ensues. Values can also differ sharply, ideally leading to new insights and fine-tuning that improves things going forward. For now, there can be some unrest. With a bit of creativity, a bit of discontent can motivate you to make needed changes. Watch for impulsiveness in love relationships and with communications right now.

Today's New Moon sets a theme for the weeks ahead, dear Cancer, and it falls in a house of your solar chart that's strongly connected to your own sign: the home and family sector. As such, you feel comfortable and natural with this energy, even though there can be tensions to manage. You may feel a strong prompt to take the lead or start fresh on the home front, with family, or in your relationship with yourself and your inner world. You might pick up home projects or make resolutions to better organize your home life. Matters of the heart, security, and comfort are in focus. With a Venus-Mars square today, tensions can surface, hopefully inspiring creative changes. However, there can be conflicts and impatience to navigate. Frustrations can revolve around getting what you want, but it may be impatience itself that's tripping you up more than anything. You might be focusing on a particular desire that, when attained, is not as satisfying as you imagined it would be. It isn't easy to know what you truly want just for now. Spending and relating can be problematic with this transit that's impulsive, confrontational, and impractical. Sudden attractions can come as easily as sudden turn-offs, as this aspect tends to highlight areas of dissatisfaction. Possessiveness or competitiveness can be themes. Aim to let difficult energies blow over or use them to inspire you to improve and produce. It's best not to mix emotions and practical matters for now.

Today's New Moon awakens a need to reach out, learn, connect, and share in satisfying, concrete ways, dear Leo. Catching up and staying connected is likely to boost your morale in the week ahead, as you feel good about yourself and your contributions. This can be an active cycle for writing, speaking, and schooling. With retrograde Venus forming a square with Mars today, different perspectives can be frustrating, even if they turn out to be good learning experiences. Still, it's best to recognize that conflicts today may focus too much on surface problems, leaving core issues untouched. Looking more closely at what's happening can be helpful. Now isn't the best time to ask for what you want or push a new idea. Watch for impulsiveness since desires come on quickly, as do waves of anger! This transit tends to highlight dissatisfaction or disagreement. Since impulsive Mars is currently in your sign, this can affect you more than others, and you could very well find that people are pushing your buttons. Or, if you're feeling a little on edge or unsatisfied, the temptation to rile others up can creep in. Examine what comes to the surface now, since you're likely to uncover previously buried frustrations, and these can help you find ways to resolve them. Seek a change of scenery, which can refresh you. Challenges now can lead to a new understanding of others and your own needs.

Today's New Moon today begins a productive period for taking charge of a business, project, money-making idea, savings account, budget, dear Virgo, or anything that helps you build up or manage your resources. You might decide to recommit to an old plan, project, or resolution. This lunation cleans the slate and opens doors for you in the areas of personal finances and resources. For best results, look for ways to work better with what you have before seeking to expand since the planetary ruler of this New Moon is retrograde. Conflicts or tensions today might awaken you to a new perspective on a matter as retrograde Venus forms a square with Mars today. However, the lessons you learn may not come in a pretty package! Desires may feel very pressing now, and you may face irritating competitiveness or internal pressure to perform. You can be feeling especially sensitive and may put up a protective wall around you to cope. However, if you give off the impression that your skin is thick, you could end up with hurt feelings, so a middle ground would be ideal.

The New Moon occurs in your sign today, dear Libra, prompting a sense that you're starting anew. As exciting as this fresh energy feels, do your best not to push things that could find you running out of steam and encountering opposition. This is a time for reinventing yourself in some meaningful way, or for a personal new beginning. You're in the spotlight and, even with some uncertainty, you feel you're in the driver's seat. This year's New Moon occurs when your ruler, Venus, is retrograde, making it important to avoid making too-quick decisions and choices, particularly if you're extremely busy or not quite organized. Watch for a slapdash approach to your money or belongings as Venus forms a square to Mars today. You may ultimately come to a whole new perspective on a business or money matter through what's playing out now, although some friction is likely in the process. Sometimes clashes don't have quick resolutions, but they may help redirect your energy. Tensions today tend to revolve around differences in methods, values, and approaches. If you're not in touch with your true desires, you may be chasing superficial ones today. This Venus-Mars square can be a very creative combination, but it tends to stir up dissatisfaction with current conditions first.

Today's New Moon activates the sign just behind yours, dear Scorpio. It gives you a boost of energy for tying up loose ends, closing up projects, dealing with private matters, and taking better care of your emotional health. Events and realizations occurring now remind you to slow down and get time for rest and reflection. You're in an excellent position to process recent events and find ways to leave dysfunctional matters behind. This way, you free up emotional space for inviting new energy into your life. The days and week ahead are good for physical and psychological replenishment. You might consider ways to bring more quiet time for reflection into your life. Still, today's Venus-Mars square can be impatient, brusque, or demanding. You may need to be extra careful with how you handle touchy situations and people. Try not to burn yourself out by pushing too hard or expecting instant results. Aim not to talk ahead of yourself or jump into action too quickly based solely on momentary emotions. You may need to deal with frustrating blocks or misunderstandings, but rising above them is possible with some patience. Desires that come on suddenly today may not be a true reflection of what you want or need. Note that dissatisfaction with a current situation can be harder to ignore, and it could motivate you to make improvements.

Today's New Moon launches a new cycle and fresh start in your social life or with happiness goals, causes, and projects, dear Sagittarius. You'll want to feel you belong and that you contribute to something bigger than yourself now, and you can be focusing on improving or developing friendships, networking, generating business income, drawing up long-term plans, joining groups, and sharing your expertise with others. Cooperation and delegation make the most sense right now, bringing rewards. Some issues today may not be well-received, with retrograde Venus in your privacy sector forming a square to Mars in your house of expansion. Inner frustration or angst may be hard to ignore. Clashes could happen if you, or the people around you, are succumbing to impatience as you try to satisfy your desires. Sensitivity to feelings doesn't come as naturally with this transit in play today. Desires can come on suddenly, but may only be a reflection of inner unrest, and thus may not be genuine. A tense atmosphere can make it difficult to look past small problems and challenges, but if you can manage to do so, it can go a long way towards reinstating calm. Plus, you might learn a lot about your needs in the process.

The New Moon today begins a cycle in which your responsibilities and long-term goals are in the spotlight, dear Capricorn, and perhaps you are as well! You could be more in demand at this time. Business and career matters, or decisions about significant crossroads and life paths or direction, can be in focus now. Refining your overarching life plan makes sense as you feel more goal-oriented. The ruler of this area of your solar chart is retrograde, and it's forming a square to Mars today, making it important to avoid impulsiveness. Tempers might flare today, and frustrations can emerge. You may think filling a sudden desire will solve all your problems, but it's likely just a distraction. Dig deeper, and you may find that the surface topic has little to do with the real problem. You could feel torn between filling your own needs and pleasing someone, and there could be a sense that you're out of rhythm with them. This transit can stir up dissatisfaction, and feelings are complicated right now. Problems from the past can re-emerge. If you keep your expectations in check, you may be able to roll with the competitive energy, and it might fuel your motivation to make improvements.

Today's New Moon can serve as a powerful motivator, through events and discoveries, to take a fresh approach to learning and living, dear Aquarius. In the coming days and weeks, you can be eager to broaden your experience and deepen your understanding of your life's purpose. Branching out into unexplored territory can be enriching and inspiring, whether mentally or physically. There can be a tense atmosphere in spots today due to a Venus-Mars square, but there is much to learn from your interactions. Rhythms in love or patterns in relating can be a little off, leaving it difficult to find satisfaction. Feelings run hot and cold, mainly due to timing problems and impatience. A straightforward approach may go over as insensitive, but holding back may be interpreted as indifference. Differences in approach aren't always a sign of a deeper problem, but sometimes clashes lead to important realizations. Right now, Venus is retrograde, and old problems can come back to your attention. There can be a disagreement or discontent stirred that motivates you to make improvements, ultimately. Reactions can be quick, and people may be working on a short fuse. But while there can be a temperamental or competitive tone to the day, you're gaining deeper insight into your work, goals, or ambitions through a bit of trial and error.

Today's New Moon may offer a chance to start fresh, dear Pisces, and it occurs in the area of your solar chart that rules many of the things that go on behind closed doors or deep inside of you. It can stir up your need or desire for intimacy and closeness, and also a burning itch to get to the bottom of matters or to absorb yourself in a special project or endeavor. Self-understanding may also be a goal now! The week ahead can feature some analysis, research, and investigation. Events around now may alert you to the need to manage debt or deal with outstanding issues that keep you from feeling empowered and in charge. Particularly when it comes to relationships, finances, self-worth, and respect, life seems to be showing you where you need to make changes and improvements. With today's Venus-Mars square, you may be dealing with some contrariness, and you may feel the need to revisit plans, schedules, or statements. People around you can be temperamental and competitive as this transit tends to highlight differences in needs, desires, and approaches. Be protective of information or feelings that you typically want to keep quiet, as there is an impulsive tendency that could be cause for later regret. Even so, frictions today can lead to new insights and a better understanding of yourself and others. It can be worthwhile to observe your reactions today so that you can better understand your needs.
